structuredData.summary: Auto-switch to async mode for workflows that are sequential with multiple steps, contain retries, or have a high explicit timeout.
keyPoints: Default `waitForCompletion` to `false` when omitted if `(spec.mode === 'sequential' && spec.steps.length > 1) || jobs.some(j => (j.retries ?? 0) > 0) || (spec.timeoutMs ?? 0) > 25000`.
Effectively mitigates MCP client-side timeouts (typically 30-60s) for high-latency orchestration paths.
Preserves synchronous 'fire-and-wait' behavior for single-job workflows without retries, maintaining simplicity for fast tasks.
Recommendation: Update the execution logic in `src/features/orchestration/mcp/register-tools.ts` to evaluate this heuristic after normalization but before the completion check.
